summary: Preserve validated conversation subject hints through local reads and internal owner forwarding without a database index

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery changes. Ownership is still validated against exact history status at the requested snapshot and the existing managed-session hash.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. Exact subject reads use existing subject indexes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordinated-upgrade requirement.

compatibility.detail: Public client contracts, session IDs and existing peer JSON are unchanged. Optional internal HTTP metadata selects an exact lookup only after hash validation; old owners ignore it and old gateways omit it. Missing or mismatched hints use existing roster resolution, without changing the authenticated authority actor or permissions.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption. A peer or gateway running an older build retains the existing owner-resolution performance until upgraded.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required; identity and stored state are preserved.

recovery.detail: No persistent state change or new binary swap-back restriction. Older builds ignore optional HTTP metadata and retain existing peer JSON handling.
